newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Li & Fung announces changes to board.
newsitem.headline: Li & Fung announces changes to board.

text.p: Li & Fung Ltd, the listed trading arm of the Li & Fung group, said on Tuesday Richard Napier had resigned from its board and Steven Small had been appointed as a non-executive director.
Napier had been a company director since 1995 and is leaving Hong Kong for a new assignment, Li & Fung said in a statement.
Napier is managing director of Minorco Services (HK) Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of Consolidated Resources Ltd, where he is also a director.
Small is an executive director of Consolidated Resources and managing director of Minorco Services (Singapore) Pte Ltd.
